organisation.name: Organisation Control Centre
organisation.mission: Build a coordinated, resilient organisation with diversified, sustainable revenue and disciplined risk controls.
organisation.strategic_priority: Establish the organisation and develop AI Revenue as an early funding engine in parallel.
owner_approval_required_for: live trades, wallet connections, signing, deposits, or withdrawals
repository merges and security or permission changes

divisions.name: Executive Management
divisions.mandate: Set organisation-wide priorities, coordinate divisions, resolve dependencies, and maintain accountable reporting.
divisions.approval_boundary: Advisory and coordination authority only; owner retains reserved approvals.

divisions.name: AI Revenue
divisions.mandate: Validate legitimate income opportunities and deliver useful AI-assisted services and tools with a zero-upfront-cost default.
divisions.approval_boundary: Research, draft, build, test, and prepare offers; no applications, client contact, claims, launches, or paid commitments without approval.

divisions.name: Technology and Infrastructure
divisions.mandate: Build, secure, test, document, and integrate shared technical systems.
divisions.approval_boundary: Development on isolated branches is permitted; merges, deployments, credential access, and permission changes require approval.

divisions.name: Research and Intelligence
divisions.mandate: Provide sourced market, platform, technical, and opportunity intelligence with uncertainty clearly labelled.
divisions.approval_boundary: Research and recommendations only; no external commitments.

divisions.name: Finance and Treasury
divisions.mandate: Maintain financial models, cash-flow visibility, budget controls, reserves planning, and financing research.
divisions.approval_boundary: No account access, transfers, borrowing, investments, or financial transactions without explicit approval; halal constraints must be assessed.

divisions.name: Risk, Security and Recovery
divisions.mandate: Identify cross-division risks, validate safeguards, coordinate incident response, and maintain recovery plans.
divisions.approval_boundary: May advise, flag, and recommend stopping unsafe activity; cannot authorise execution or override deterministic controls.

divisions.name: Crypto and PolyBot
divisions.mandate: Develop research, simulation, risk, and position-management capabilities with strict separation from live execution.
divisions.approval_boundary: Paper/research work only unless a separate explicit live-operation approval and readiness review are completed.

divisions.name: Ecommerce
divisions.mandate: Maintain existing work and later develop ecommerce automation and commercial operations.
divisions.approval_boundary: Major development deferred; no listings, purchases, publishing, or account changes without approval.

divisions.name: Animora and Future Creative Studio
divisions.mandate: Preserve the long-term ambition to grow Animora into a broader independent media and creative production studio.
divisions.approval_boundary: No current spending commitment; expansion follows sustainable success of the main organisation.
